representative.title: Rockstar UK staff vote overwhelmingly against union recognition
representative.summary: Rockstar Games' roughly 1,600 UK-based staff voted against recognizing the IWGB-affiliated Rockstar Game Workers Union, in a ballot that ran from November 12 to November 26. The vote follows a voluntary recognition request workers filed in June 2026 and comes alongside a separate ongoing tribunal over 2025 firings.

representative.title: Marvelous offers early retirement, aims to cut 65 jobs in Consumer Business Division
representative.summary: Marvelous Inc., developer of Story of Seasons and Rune Factory, launched a voluntary "External Career Transition Support Program" targeting 65 roles in its console/PC Consumer Business Division as it shifts more development to outside studios. Applications run December 14, 2026 to January 8, 2027, with departures by March 31, 2027 and a lump-sum payment.

representative.title: New Radical Games' Simpsons: Hit & Run remake reportedly cancelled
representative.summary: 据报道, New Radical Games senior designer Darren Evenson said on LinkedIn that the studio's unannounced project was scrapped as part of a wider round of cancellations, fueling speculation that a rumored Simpsons: Hit & Run remake has been cancelled. Evenson did not explicitly confirm the project was Hit & Run, so VGC flags the identification as unconfirmed.

representative.title: Fans race to port leaked 209GB GTA 6 PC build, with some reporting 60FPS unlocked in parts
representative.summary: 据报道 (IT之家), after a leak of roughly 209GB of Grand Theft Auto VI game files, independent developers worldwide are racing to port the console build to PC, with one porting effort reportedly reaching 91.3% completion and some play sessions unlocking 60FPS in certain scenes. This is community/unofficial activity, not an official Rockstar PC release, and details are unconfirmed beyond the report.
